item_short_desc: Rothco's Tactical Watch Cap is constructed with extra warm polar fleece material, designed to keep you warm in the harshest environments. Whether you are tackling the great outdoors or in the middle of a tactical operation, this watch cap provides the insulation and comfort you need. The tactical cap features a loop field on the front, allowing you to attach flag or morale patches for a personalized touch (patches sold separately). Its low-profile design ensures it can fit comfortably under a helmet, making it versatile for various activities.
